bootstrap_notes: Before any work run `python3 scripts/check_failures.py`. At session start read this week's comments on the one live board in Control Centre, as `docs/PUBLISH_BOARDS.md` says. Studio work requires `docs/ENGINE_SESSION.md`, `studio.session.open` and its tracked capability set; cloud Studio sessions stay read-only. Preserve observer attribution and Krish's actual decisions, keep exact feedback excerpts and never whole transcripts. `Video engine` remains the exact external launcher.

changes.basis: content-engine CLAUDE.md makes docs/REPO_MAP.md a mandatory first read; the publisher fetches only profile sources, so every run since at least 2026-10-20 ended bootstrap_source_missing (state/repository-administration/latest.json at 0019e00 and later).
re-measured with scripts/repository-admin.mjs bootstrapMeasure against content-engine main once docs/REPO_MAP.md is counted; the old limit predates that file being read

changes.from: At session start read comments on EVERY board link in `config/boards.json`; each board publish updates every link from the same engine-built file.
changes.to: At session start read this week's comments on the one live board in Control Centre, as `docs/PUBLISH_BOARDS.md` says.
changes.basis: Ruling (Krish, 2026-11-11): one live board, in Control Centre; the old board is a read-only archive. Krish, 2026-11-12: "does every part of the engine know that this new publish board is the only place to put stuff and how to use it?" The note still sent every session to read comments on every config/boards.json link and said each board publish updates every link (the two-account artifact era); the board workflow did not read docs/PUBLISH_BOARDS.md, the authority. Record: the ruling is recorded in krishanraja/content-engine docs/PUBLISH_BOARDS.md ("One live board") by krishanraja/content-engine#544 (merge a18ffe22); the sweep that applied it is krishanraja/content-engine#578 and krishanraja/control-center#709.
